description: Project configuration for jackstay. Run jst check for semantic and cross-field validation.

$schema.description: Points editors at the JSON Schema of one jackstay release, for completion and early diagnostics; `jst check` stays the judge.

adopt.description: Holds what `jst adopt` keeps in the project's file: the workflows' pin, the profile and the conflicts kept on purpose.

exceptions.description: Keeps adoption conflicts on purpose, each by its ID with the reason the project gives.

pin.description: Names the jst release the generated workflows download, moved only by `jst adopt --pin`.

profile.description: Names the profile `jst adopt` and `jst doctor` read, relative to the project's root unless it starts with `/` or `~/`.

profile_sha256.description: Pins the profile bundle to this SHA-256 digest (64 hex digits), so a later plan or apply refuses a changed bundle.

baseline.description: Says what `jst baseline` counts when it measures the project's test runs, merges and destructive commands.

branch.description: Names the branch whose merges `jst baseline` counts.

kinds.description: Lists the kinds of test run `jst baseline` counts; a Bash call takes the first kind one of its simple commands matches.

gate.description: Marks the kind as one that stands before a merge, so `jst baseline` measures its overlap with other gate runs.

name.description: Names the kind in the report; two kinds cannot share a name.

pattern.description: Matches one simple command of this kind (RE2). Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

merge_unit.description: Tells `jst baseline` what a merge is: `pr` counts first-parent subjects ending in `(#N)`, `commit` counts the branch's commits.

transcripts.description: Names the Claude Code session folders `jst baseline` reads, as patterns over folder names without `/`.

max_age_hours.description: Keeps a saved brief fresh for this many hours when `jst brief save` is given no `--max-age` (1 to 720, default 168). Hours a saved brief stays fresh when jst brief save is given no --max-age.

cards.description: Turns on the `Card:` line: which commits must name their cards, where the cards are, and from when the rule holds.

branch.description: Names the branch whose history `jst cards` reads and whose pushes the guard checks for `Card:` lines (default `main`).

dir.description: Names the folder of card files, written from the repository's root.

exempt_branches.description: Lists head branches whose pull requests are judged by the tree's rules only, without `Card:` lines (a bot's branch).

first_new.description: Names the first card number under the new rules: cards numbered from it up keep `"commits": []`.

id.description: Matches a card ID (RE2, without inline flags). Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

since.description: Reads commits dated on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) strictly, and earlier ones loosely.

snapshots.description: Names the folder where `jst cards snapshot --write` keeps what landed, for after a history rewrite.

unit.description: Says where `Card:` lines are written: `pr` in the pull request's description, `commit` in each commit's message.

changes.description: Keeps the changelog as one entry file per change, collected into the changelog at release.

dir.description: Names the folder of changelog entry files, written from the repository's root.

heading.description: Gives the heading of each released section; it holds `{version}` and may hold `{date}`.

internal_into.description: Names the file that internal entries are collected into; without it they go only into the release commit's message and the release pull request.

into.description: Names the changelog file that entries are collected into.

newest.description: Puts the newest section `first` or `last` in the changelog (default `last`).

template.description: Names the file `jst changes new` copies for a new entry, with `{card}` and `{slug}` filled in.

chat.description: Turns on session chat between agent sessions of this repository.

claude_code.description: Configures the Claude Code hook that announces pending chat messages at the next boundary.

enabled.description: Lets `jst chat claude-hook` announce pending messages to Claude Code; it needs `chat.enabled`.

codex_bridge.description: Configures the bridge that delivers chat messages into a managed Codex turn.

enabled.description: Lets `jst chat codex-bridge` deliver messages to a running Codex turn; it needs `chat.enabled`.
Turns session chat on for this repository; chat commands refuse to run without it.

github.description: Says which GitHub account, remote and repository jackstay uses, and how long its GitHub commands wait.

account.description: Names the GitHub login jackstay acts as outside GitHub Actions, whatever account `gh` has active.

remote.description: Names the remote that `jst sync`, `jst start`, `jst tidy` and `jst land` use; without it they take `origin`, else the remote `main` (then `master`) tracks, else the only remote.

repository.description: Names the repository as `owner/name` when it is not to be read from the remote's URL.

wait.description: Sets the defaults of `jst checks wait`, `jst checks run-wait` and `jst land`; their flags still win.

interval_seconds.description: Waits this many seconds between looks at GitHub (default 20).

log_lines.description: Shows this many lines of a failed step's log (default 25).

timeout_seconds.description: Gives up waiting on GitHub after this many seconds (default 1800).

guard.description: Adapts the guard to the project: extra regenerable folders, the project's own rules, and each built-in rule's level.

deny.description: Adds the project's own rules, each refusing commands its patterns match and shown as `project:<id>`.

command.description: Refuses a command whose words, joined by spaces, match this pattern (RE2). Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

additionalProperties.description: Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

env.description: Applies the rule only when each named environment variable's whole value matches its pattern (RE2), or cannot be known.

id.description: Names the rule in refusals as `project:<id>` (default `rule`).

instead.description: Tells the agent what to run instead (default "ask the owner").

unless.description: Lets a command through when its words, joined by spaces, match this pattern (RE2). Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

why.description: Says why the rule refuses (default "this project refuses it (jackstay.json)").

regenerable.description: Adds folder names that may always be deleted inside the project, beside the built-in ones (`.build`, `node_modules`, …); `jst tidy` reads them too.

additionalProperties.description: Sets one built-in rule's level and, for `rm-recursive` and `find-delete`, its path exceptions.

level.description: Makes the rule `refuse`, `warn` (the command runs and the agent is told) or `off` (default `refuse`, `warn` for `zsh-glob`).

paths.description: Allows a recursive delete under these folders, written below the project's top or below `~/` (only `rm-recursive` and `find-delete`).

rules.description: Sets the level and path exceptions of built-in guard rules, by rule id.

additionalProperties.description: Defines one number series: where its files are and how its numbers are written.

also_in.description: Names files whose numbers of this series also count as taken (an old ledger's rows), written from the repository's root.

files.description: Gives the path pattern of the series' files, with `{n}` once in the file's name where the number is.

width.description: Pads the number with zeros to this many digits, 1 to 9 (default 1).

ids.description: Declares the number series that `jst id` hands out, by series name.

jackstay_schema.description: Says which jackstay the file was written for (1 to 3), so an older jackstay refuses keys it does not know instead of half-reading them.

land.description: Says how `jst land` lands a change: who merges, which method, which checks are required and which paths only a person lands.

autonomy.description: Chooses who merges: `merge-when-green` (the agent, when the required checks pass and no human path is touched) or `prepare` (a person).

checks.description: Names checks required in addition to the base's rules, never fewer.

host.description: Names the code host's adapter (`github`); unset, the push remote's host.

human_paths.description: Lists globs of paths only a person lands, besides jackstay.json, CI workflows and .claude/settings.json.

method.description: Chooses the merge method asked of the host: `squash` (the default), `merge` or `rebase`.

lock.description: Turns on the machine-wide lock that heavy test runs take in turn.

also_hold.description: Names older lock files that a locked run holds together with the shared lock.

held_env.description: Names the environment variable set for the command while the older lock is held, so the older script does not wait for itself.

path.description: Gives the older lock's file, an absolute path or one beginning `~/`.

enabled.description: Makes `jst test` take the machine-wide lock for this project (off by default; `--lock` and `--no-lock` decide one call).

default_minutes.description: Stops a `jst bg` command after this many minutes when `--for` is not given (default 30).

max_minutes.description: Caps any `jst bg` deadline at this many minutes (default 240).

project.description: Names the project; without it the name is the main checkout's folder name.

receipts.description: Says what goes into a tree's key and which commands may reuse a receipt of a pass instead of running again.

commands.description: Lists commands that `jst test -- COMMAND` judges, keys and may reuse, matched by their words.

argv.description: Matches the command by all its words exactly; reuse needs it.

argv_prefix.description: Matches every command that begins with these words, the longest match winning; it cannot be reused.

empty_exit.description: Reads this exit status (1 to 125) as no tests collected when the JUnit report confirms zero cases (`junit` only).

evidence.description: Counts the tests a run passed from the lines this pattern matches (RE2, one group for the number); without a count no run is `passed`. Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

judge.description: Judges the run by a structured report: `go-json`, `junit`, `jest-json`, `trx` or `xcresult-json`.

merge_bases.description: Adds the merge base of HEAD with each of these refs to this command's key.

refs.description: Adds the commit each of these refs names to this command's key.

report.description: Names the report file a file-based judge reads from the run's private report folder.

reports.description: Names several report files instead of `report`: up to 32 for `junit`, or `summary.json` and `tests.json` for `xcresult-json`.

reuse.description: Prints a stored receipt and runs nothing when this command already passed on the same key.

veto.description: Fails a run that ended 0 when a line of its output matches this pattern (RE2). Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

xcresult_bundles.description: Names every unit test bundle an `xcresult-json` report must show.

env.description: Puts the environment variables whose names match these names or patterns (`APP_*`) into the key; reuse needs it written out, even empty.

exclude.description: Leaves files matching these patterns, written from the root, out of the key's inputs.

extra_files.description: Adds these files to the key, each one readable file, also ones git ignores.

include_head.description: Adds HEAD's commit to the key.

inputs.description: Names the paths whose files make the key: the tracked ones and the untracked ones the committed `.gitignore` files do not ignore; without it there is no key.

max_age_hours.description: Uses a receipt for at most this many hours (default 72).

merge_bases.description: Adds the merge base of HEAD with each of these refs to every command's key.

no_reuse_branches.description: Always runs the command on these branches and on the commits they point at (default `main` and `master`).

refs.description: Adds the commit each of these refs names to every command's key.

toolchain.description: Adds what each of these commands prints (`[["go", "version"]]`) to the key; reuse and scope steps need it written out, even empty.

additionalProperties.description: Defines where one series' record files live and how `jst view` shows them; the series needs an `ids` entry of the same name.

before.description: Names the series' old ledger file, kept frozen: `jst lint tree` refuses a new row in it.

columns.description: Lists the front matter fields `jst view` shows as columns (default `id`).

dir.description: Names the folder of the series' record files, written from the repository's root.

template.description: Names the file `jst new` copies for a new record.

records.description: Keeps the records of these series as one file each, rendered by `jst view`.

release.description: Turns on releases made by a release pull request: versions, tag and changelog are written by `jst release`.

base.description: Names the branch releases are made from and land on (default `cards.branch`, else `main`).

branch.description: Names the release pull request's head branch (default `jackstay/release`).

build.description: Names an app's build number file and its pattern, with one named group `build`.

match.description: Finds the build number in the file (RE2, multi-line, one group named `build`). Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

path.description: Names the build number file, written from the repository's root.

files.description: Lists the version files a release rewrites; at least one is required.

match.description: Finds the version in the file (RE2, multi-line, one group named `version`). Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

path.description: Names the version file, written from the repository's root.

first.description: Gives the version the version files hold when the section is added; tags at or below it are history jackstay does not read.

merge.description: Says who merges the release pull request: `owner` (it opens as a draft) or `agents` (default `owner`).

tag.description: Names the release tag, holding `{version}` once (default `v{version}`).

review.description: Configures `jst review`: the reviewers, what they are told, and how findings decide a round.

blocking.description: Lists the severities that fail a round (default `blocker`).

brief.description: Names the project's standing brief, read from the reviewed tree and put at the top of every prompt.

cite.description: Lists files and folders (trailing `/`) the reviewer is told to read as the measure; each must exist in the reviewed tree (default `AGENTS.md` when it exists).

keep_days.description: Removes a task whose newest round is older than this many days, 1 to 3650 (default 30).

max_concurrent.description: Lets this project's reviews hold at most this many reviewer runs at once on the machine (default 4).

queue_minutes.description: Waits at most this many minutes for a source view, reviewer slots and the start lock, 1 to 120 (default 15).

repeat_rounds.description: Says a place is to be redesigned once it draws a finding this many rounds running, at least 2 (default 2).

repeat_severities.description: Lists the severities that count as repeats for redesign (default every severity but the last).

additionalProperties.description: Overrides one built-in reviewer's command, model, effort, deadline and isolation flags.

command.description: Runs the reviewer as this program, a name on `PATH` or an absolute path (default `codex` for Codex, `claude` for Claude Code).

effort.description: Sets the reviewer's reasoning effort; empty passes none (default `medium` for Codex, the CLI's own for Claude Code).

isolation.description: Replaces Codex's default isolation flags with these words; words jackstay owns are refused, and Claude Code takes none.

model.description: Passes this model to the reviewer; empty keeps the CLI's own default.

timeout_minutes.description: Stops one reviewer run after this many minutes, 1 to 120 (default 20).

reviewers.description: Overrides the built-in reviewers' settings, by name: `codex` or `claude-code`.

round_limit.description: Stops after this round and asks the owner, at least 2 (default 6).

severities.description: Lists the severity words a finding may carry, most severe first (default `blocker`, `major`, `minor`).

store.description: Keeps review results in this folder, an absolute path or one beginning `~/`; empty keeps them under `~/.jackstay/<project>/reviews`.

template.description: Replaces jackstay's prompt template with this file (Go `text/template`), read from the reviewed tree.

triage.description: Sorts each finding by likelihood and consequence, so only realistic ones block; off, every finding of a blocking severity blocks (default true).

use.description: Lists the reviewers a round runs when `--reviewer` is absent, and those `jst review check` requires (default `codex`).

repos.description: Lists the repositories `jst status` reads when none are named: paths relative to this file's folder, or absolute.

telemetry.description: Sets how long the local journal is kept and how command text is recorded in it.

commands.description: Records command text `masked` (secrets hidden) or as a `skeleton` (only its shape) (default `masked`).

compress_after_days.description: Gzips a journal day file older than this many days, 1 to 3650 (default 14).

keep_days.description: Deletes a journal day file older than this many days, 1 to 3650 and not below `compress_after_days` (default 180).

test.description: Declares the project's test scopes and steps, their judges and timeouts, run by `jst test <scope>`.

expect.description: Lists the engines (`xctest`, `swift-testing`) every `swift-test` scope must show markers of, unless the scope sets its own (default `xctest`).

judge.description: Judges every scope and step that sets no judge of its own (default `exit`).

leftovers.description: Lists file globs a test run must not leave behind.

fail.description: Fails the run when its leftovers match the glob; false lists them.

glob.description: Matches leftover files; `~`, `$TMPDIR`, `{run_id}` and `{run_tmp}` are expanded, and a glob holding the run's token is attributed exactly.

additionalProperties.description: Defines one scope: the command it runs or the steps it lists, how it is judged, and when the project runs it.

base.description: Gives the ref that `{base}` in the words stands for; `--base REF` overrides it.

cwd.description: Runs the command in this folder of the checkout instead of its root.

durations.description: Records each test class's seconds for `{slow}` (default on for `full` and `display` under `swift-test`).

empty_exit.description: Reads this exit status (1 to 125) as no tests collected when the JUnit report confirms zero cases (`junit` only).

env.description: Sets these environment variables for the run; they are recorded.

evidence.description: Counts the tests a run passed from the lines this pattern matches (RE2, one group for the number); the `steps` judge needs it. Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

expect.description: Lists the engines (`xctest`, `swift-testing`) whose markers a `swift-test` run must show (default `test.expect`, else `xctest`).

judge.description: Says how the run's outcome is read: `swift-test`, `steps`, `exit`, `go-json`, `junit`, `jest-json`, `trx` or `xcresult-json` (default `test.judge`, else `exit`).

lock.description: Takes the machine-wide lock when `lock.enabled` is true (default true, false for `focused` and `quick`).

lock_wait.description: Gives up waiting for the lock after this many seconds (default the scope's timeout).

report.description: Names the report file a file-based judge reads; `{report}` in the words gives its path.

reports.description: Names several report files instead of `report`: up to 32 for `junit`, or `summary.json` and `tests.json` for `xcresult-json`.

requires.description: Lists checks run first; one that fails or times out makes the outcome `not-started` and nothing runs.

run.description: Runs these words as the check.

timeout.description: Stops the check after this many seconds (default 60).

why.description: Says what the run reports when the check fails.

resume.description: Lets `jst test gate --resume` skip this step after a pass on the same tree; false always runs it (default true).

run.description: Runs these words, with placeholders such as `{tests}`, `{base}`, `{slow}` and `{report}` filled in.

selector.description: Expands one test ID into the runner's filter: `go-test` or `jest-test`, for a `focused` or `x-` scope.

slow.description: Defines which test classes `{slow}` skips, from their recorded durations.

case_seconds.description: Skips a class whose median slowest case takes at least this many seconds.

class_seconds.description: Skips a class whose median total takes at least this many seconds.

steps.description: Runs these steps or scopes in order instead of `run`, stopping at the first that does not pass.

timeout.description: Stops the whole process tree after this many seconds of the command's run (default `test.timeout`).

veto.description: Fails a run when a line of its output matches this pattern (RE2), whatever its status. Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

when.description: Says when the project runs this scope, one line that `jst test list` prints.

xcresult_bundles.description: Names every unit test bundle an `xcresult-json` report must show.

scopes.description: Declares the scopes `jst test <scope>` runs: `focused`, `changed`, `quick`, `full`, `display`, `gate`, or `x-` extras.

selection.description: Lets `jst test changed` choose a scope from the paths changed since a base.

order.description: Orders the scopes from least to most strict, ending with `gate`; the strictest scope any rule picks wins.

rules.description: Maps changed paths to scopes; a path no rule matches selects `gate`.

glob.description: Matches changed paths, written from the repository's root; `**` stands for whole path segments.

scope.description: Names the scope a matching path selects, one of `test.selection.order`.

additionalProperties.description: Defines one step: the command it runs or the steps it lists, and how it is judged.

evidence.description: Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

veto.description: Go RE2 regular expression; validate with jst check.

steps.description: Declares the steps a scope's `steps` lists, with the same keys as a scope.

timeout.description: Stops a scope or step without a timeout of its own after this many seconds.

trash.description: Sets how `jst trash` keeps what it removes.

keep_days.description: Keeps a trash entry for this many days (default 7).

title: jackstay.json
